Name: Village Garden Church - 546
Natural: Collectible miniature old-world church. Handcrafted weather-resistant fiber-reinforced cement. Removable roof is great for hiding a key. Beautiful and durable structure lasts for years to come. Dimensions: 14.5L x 9.5W x 12.5H inches. Great for use as a lantern or a repository for small garden tools, the highly decorative Village Garden Church by Brookfield is a one-of-a-kind lawn ornament that's sure to be the focal point of your garden. This piece perfectly captures the spirit of the old world in rich detail. From the white tabby sides to the wooden door and hand-wrought copper cross, this model church really comes alive. And since its been crafted by hand from fiber reinforced cement tabby, it's also built to last through the worst weather Mother Nature has to offer. One of the church's most creative features is a removable roof that's great for a variety of uses like hiding a spare house key! This collectible church weighs 42 lbs. and is approximately 14.5L x 9.5W x 12.5H inches. Minimal care is required.
